correctness.rationale: Exact Schur-complement tree determinant recursion gives every adjacency eigenvalue as a cosine of a rational angle with reduced denominator at most h+2; each factor has positive multiplicity. An eigenvector vanishing at all leaves vanishes identically, and automorphism transitivity forces nonzero projection of a given leaf onto every eigenspace. The cyclic-subspace dimension hence equals the number of distinct eigenvalues, a summatory-totient count. Radial Jacobi cyclicity gives root rank h+1. Positivity of sink strength strictly damps the bright sector and leaves the orthogonal dark sector unitary, so for I/N the captured probability is precisely bright dimension/N. Finite modular checks in two fields and four symbolic factorization instances corroborate but do not replace the all-parameter proof; homogeneous hopping, perfect tree and positive gamma are essential.

value.rationale: A natural physical observable—the irreversible capture probability from a uniform incoherent excitation—depends sharply on the detector placement. A leaf accesses all distinct spectral energies, yielding an exact totient-summatory rank independent of branching, while the root accesses only h+1 radial modes. The quadratic-versus-linear contrast applies at every depth and quantifies a previously uncomputed exact operational law, motivated by known geometry-dependent quantum transport and classical trap-placement questions. No finite-table recomputation or arbitrary parameter cutoff is claimed as the contribution.
